analysis.purpose: CliVcsAdapter is a thin TypeScript class that implements the VcsAdapter interface for the CLI package. It delegates current-head and changed-files queries to standalone utility functions, letting the CLI consume a uniform VcsAdapter abstraction without embedding git logic directly.
responsibilities: Implement the VcsAdapter contract for the CLI package
Delegate currentHead queries to the currentHead utility
Delegate changedFilesSince queries to the changedFilesSince utility
errorBehavior: No local error handling; errors from delegated utilities propagate to callers
invariants: Every public method is a pure pass-through to a utility of the same name
preconditions: The currentHead and changedFilesSince utilities must be available and implement the expected signatures
postconditions: Adapter methods return exactly what the underlying utilities return
risks: Adapter behavior is entirely dependent on unresolved utility implementations
No validation or fallback if the utilities throw or return unexpected shapes
whatToDistrust: coverage.readiness is 'unimplemented' / bodyPresent false despite a short sourceBody showing delegation; behavior should be treated as spec-only
The delegated currentHead and changedFilesSince utilities are not resolved in this seed
